observation.claim: The candidate fails BOTH surface arms (bare and compiled) with severe slop + token cap; the base passes BOTH.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: the candidate's failure is model/training/decoding, NOT the context compiler
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: same failure on bare and compiled → the compiler is not the differentiator
causal_hypotheses.contradicting_evidence: only one compiled packet length was tested
competing_explanations: long-packet salience effects beyond the tested packet

proposed_interventions.intervention: do NOT invest in the context compiler on this evidence; investigate the training recipe (steps/LR/overfitting) instead
proposed_interventions.expected_effect: avoid mis-attributing a model/training failure to the compiler
proposed_interventions.risk: the untested long-packet regime could still hide a compiler issue
proposed_interventions.cost: low (a reasoning constraint, not a build)
proposed_interventions.validation_plan: run the packet-length family before any compiler work

observation.claim: The candidate degenerates (severe, token-capped) at BOTH short and long lengths; the base degrades only on the long arm.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: the candidate overfit (28 records, ~5 epochs) into a repetition attractor that fires even on short generations
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: consistent with Dispatch-20 evidence (LoRA-20 min-loss 0.08, memorized-style outputs); token-cap 9/20 vs base 3/20
competing_explanations: decoding (greedy) interacting with an overfit model
learning rate too high for the data size
causal_hypotheses.required_disambiguating_test: the existing-checkpoint curve (step-10 vs step-20): if step-10 is cleaner, it is over-exposure, not method

proposed_interventions.intervention: fewer steps / earlier stopping and/or lower exposure per example
proposed_interventions.expected_effect: reduce degeneration if the curve is non-monotone
proposed_interventions.validation_plan: checkpoint curve + a bounded confirmation run

observation.claim: The base cleanly APPLIES canon in prose (pass/none) but fails to EXTRACT clean JSON (invalid_json); the candidate degenerates on both.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: the base's canon weakness is a STRUCTURED-OUTPUT (JSON) problem, not a canon-reasoning problem
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: base applies canon correctly in prose but emits invalid JSON for extraction
causal_hypotheses.required_disambiguating_test: a canon-extraction item with a JSON-priming example vs bare

proposed_interventions.intervention: do NOT collapse invalid-JSON and invented-canon into one 'canon' problem in the dataset plan
proposed_interventions.expected_effect: targets the real gap (protocol) instead of over-teaching canon
proposed_interventions.validation_plan: separate structured-protocol coverage in the dataset audit

observation.claim: BOTH base and candidate fail the structured no-change wrapper (restraint-clean and revision-wrapper); this is a shared gap, not a candidate regression.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: the changed/unchanged JSON wrapper is under-taught in Dataset A (only 2 no-change golds, 0 changed:true)
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: matches the Dispatch-21 coverage finding; both models fail identically

proposed_interventions.intervention: increase no-change / changed:true protocol coverage in the NEXT dataset (not this dispatch)
proposed_interventions.expected_effect: teach the wrapper both models currently miss
proposed_interventions.validation_plan: the next controlled experiment's protocol pass-rate vs base

observation.claim: The base handles the terse single-defect revision (pass) but fails the lyrical arm; the candidate fails both.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: lyrical single-defect revision is harder (must preserve ornate register while fixing one image)
competing_explanations: the lyrical contract's forbidden imposed_minimalism is stricter
causal_hypotheses.required_disambiguating_test: reviewer judgement on whether the lyrical output was flattened vs the terse expanded

proposed_interventions.intervention: keep voice preservation as a blinded reviewer dimension (mechanical gate under-measures it)
proposed_interventions.expected_effect: captures voice flattening the gates miss

observation.claim: BOTH models fail both constraint arms (low and high load) — a shared structured/constraint weakness, not a load-sensitivity signal that separates them.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: constraint-verdict JSON shape + minimal causal-set discipline is under-taught and hard for the base
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: both fail regardless of load; base over-includes in Dispatch-20 too
competing_explanations: the low-load item is also nontrivial
causal_hypotheses.required_disambiguating_test: a JSON-primed constraint item vs bare

proposed_interventions.intervention: treat constraint-verdict protocol as a structured-output gap (with canon-extract)

observation.claim: BOTH models PASS the multi-turn arm and FAIL the single-turn arm — the opposite of the expected cumulative-damage direction; the mechanical contract may not capture the intended distinction.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: the single-turn contract (keep-last-sentence-exact) is stricter than the multi-turn one; the pair does not isolate cumulative damage mechanically
causal_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: both pass multi, fail single — inconsistent with a cumulative-damage story
causal_hypotheses.required_disambiguating_test: reviewer check of protected-span preservation across turns

proposed_interventions.intervention: revise the turn-pair contracts so the mechanical gate measures cumulative damage (equalize strictness)
proposed_interventions.risk: changes a benchmark item (a NEW battery version, not this frozen one)
proposed_interventions.validation_plan: re-run the pair after contract revision
